motivation: reviewer-requested transfer of pooled reranking from the adaptively reused test sample to the previously locked development holdout

candidate_sources.direct_pool: canonical union of validator-accepted direct-basic candidates from all four models
candidate_sources.staged_pool: canonical union of validator-accepted staged-rich candidates from all four models
candidate_sources.union_pool: canonical union of the direct and staged pools

ordering.fixed_baseline: reciprocal rank fusion with k0=60 and canonical-key tie breaking
ordering.prompt_policy: unchanged from the historical reranking experiment

inference_target: the fixed 720-record development population after exclusion of the 30-record engineering screen
analysis_policy: stratum-weighted point estimates with sampling fractions n_h/N_h and finite-population-adjusted stratified uncertainty
tuning_policy: no prompt, model, pool, metric, or RRF-constant tuning is permitted after outcomes are observed
